GOOD TO KNOW

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before visiting or calling in your order.

Is breakfast really served all day?

Yes! Our family kitchen serves all breakfast items — including our famous chorizo potato burritos, country skillets, and omelettes — from opening until close every day.

Where are you located in Scott City?

We are located on East 5th Street inside Abarrotes La Favorita (702 E 5th St, Scott City, KS 67871), with convenient parking right outside.

Do I need a table reservation?

Walk-ins are always welcome! However, for groups of 6 or more, we recommend calling ahead at (620) 909-2090 or reserving online to guarantee seating.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept cash, Visa, MasterCard, Discover, and American Express. Paying cash is also welcomed by our local counter team!
